mapper.select: SELECT airport_id, TRIM(iata_code) AS iata_code, airport_name, country, flight_type FROM AIRPORT WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN country = '대한민국' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, airport_name
SELECT seat_class_id, class_name, sort_order FROM SEAT_CLASS ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AIRPORT WHERE is_active = 'Y' AND airport_id IN ( #{departureAirportId}, #{arrivalAirportId} )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT_CLASS WHERE seat_class_id = #{seatClassId}

WITH seat_inventory AS (
SELECT f2.flight_id,
COUNT( DISTINCT s.seat_id ) AS total_seats,
COUNT( DISTINCT t.seat_id ) AS occupied_seats
FROM FLIGHT f2
JOIN SEAT s ON s.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id
AND s.seat_class_id = #{seatClassId}
AND s.is_active = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN TICKET t ON t.flight_id = f2.flight_id
AND t.seat_id = s.seat_id
AND ( t.hold_status = 'CONFIRMED'
OR ( t.hold_status = 'HOLDING'
AND ( t.expired_at IS NULL
OR t.expired_at > SYSTIMESTAMP ) ) )
GROUP BY f2.flight_id )
SELECT f.flight_id, f.flight_no,
dep.airport_id AS departure_airport_id,
TRIM(dep.iata_code) AS departure_iata_code,
dep.airport_name AS departure_airport_name,
arr.airport_id AS arrival_airport_id,
TRIM(arr.iata_code) AS arrival_iata_code,
arr.airport_name AS arrival_airport_name,
f.departure_time, f.arrival_time, f.flight_status,
NVL( f.delay_minutes, 0 ) AS delay_minutes,
ac.model_name AS aircraft_model,
departure_gate.gate_code AS departure_gate_code,
arrival_gate.gate_code AS arrival_gate_code,
sc.seat_class_id,
sc.class_name AS seat_class_name,
ff.price,
( inventory.total_seats - inventory.occupied_seats ) AS remaining_seats
FROM FLIGHT f
JOIN ROUTE r ON r.route_id = f.route_id
AND r.is_active = 'Y'
JOIN AIRPORT dep ON dep.airport_id = r.departure_airport_id
AND dep.is_active = 'Y'
JOIN AIRPORT arr ON arr.airport_id = r.arrival_airport_id
AND arr.is_active = 'Y'
JOIN AIRCRAFT ac ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id
AND ac.is_active = 'Y'
AND ac.status_name = '운항가능'
JOIN FLIGHT_FARE ff ON ff.flight_id = f.flight_id
AND ff.seat_class_id = #{seatClassId}
JOIN SEAT_CLASS sc ON sc.seat_class_id = ff.seat_class_id
JOIN seat_inventory inventory ON inventory.flight_id = f.flight_id
LEFT JOIN GATE departure_gate ON departure_gate.gate_id = f.departure_gate_id
LEFT JOIN GATE arrival_gate ON arrival_gate.gate_id = f.arrival_gate_id
WHERE r.departure_airport_id = #{departureAirportId}
AND r.arrival_airport_id = #{arrivalAirportId}
AND f.departure_time >= #{departureStart, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
AND f.departure_time < #{departureEnd, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
AND f.departure_time > SYSTIMESTAMP
AND f.flight_status IN ( 'SCHEDULED', 'DELAYED' )
AND f.is_deleted = 'N'
AND ( inventory.total_seats - inventory.occupied_seats ) >= #{passengerCount}
ORDER BY f.departure_time, ff.price
